summary: Pacific Airport Group filed a Form 6-K to report preliminary terminal passenger traffic for June 2026, showing a 5.1% total decrease versus June 2025. The filing contains only operational metrics — domestic and international passenger counts by airport — with no transaction, strategic review, or corporate action. As a routine monthly traffic update from a foreign private issuer, this is not a special-situations event. No deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation are present. There is nothing to watch from a risk-arb perspective.
